newsitem.title: UK: Panamaxes in demand on London freight market.
newsitem.headline: Panamaxes in demand on London freight market.

text.p: There were further signs on Tuesday of chartering enquiry building up for December Panamaxes in most areas, for handies in the Plate and South Africa, and for capers in the Far East.
Brokers said grain, ironore and coal charterers were all active and owners were optimistic that the December freight market would be sustained beyond the end-of-month holiday.
The BFI rose seven points to 1434.

Grain -- Andre paid a stiff $225 for 55,000/10 heavy grain US Gulf/Malaysia for early Dec loading, but Mitsubishi's fixture of Halla tonnage for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Taiwan for Dec 15/24 at $23.25 was reckoned to be relatively modest (the equivalent of about $24.00 combo for US Gulf/Japan).
There were reports of 50,000 grains 53-feet fixed up river and Bahia Blanca/Turkey for Dec loading at $22.00 but many brokers suspected the rate was incorrect and too high.
Continental wase linked with African Express 45,877 dwt delivery US Gulf for two laden legs at $9,250 daily.
Andre was understood to have covered 25,000 wheat up river/Algeria for mid December on over-age tonnage at $27.00.
Fresh Atlantic Panamax grain enquiry included MISR delivery Plate Dec 12/31 trip Egypt and Pioneer delivery south Brazil Dec 15/31 trip Skaw-Passero.
Nidera quoted 55,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Malaysia for Dec 15/25, UBC 52/54,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Japan for Dec 7/21, and Dreyfus a revised 50/70,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Egypt for Dec 10/15.
Dreyfus also quoted a new enquiry of 52/54,000 heavy grain NoPac/Japan for Dec 15/Jan 5.

Pakistan was said to have bought 225,000 tonnes Australian wheat for Dec/Jan shipment - it was believed Pan Ocean might be involved since it was open for Panamax tonnage delivery south or west Australia Dec 11/20 for a trip to Bin Qasim.
Minerals -- The steadier Caper market in the east was confirmed with CRA's fixture of Thalassini Axia 164,796 dwt delivery Japan mid Dec trip via west Australia to the Continent at $14,000 daily.
British Steel was said to have fixed SCF tonnage for 90,000/10 ironore port Cartier/Port Talbot for end December but full details were lacking.
Coal charterers were busy booking Panamaxes. Akrop 63,883 dwt, Mactrader 79,760 dwt and Captain George Tsangaris 61,349 dwt were all understood to be closely trading South African coal business.
Turkish charterers took Gulluk 63,574 dwt delivery spot Singapore trip via Gladstone to Eregli at $7,350 daily.
Panagiotis l 64,166 dwt was rumoured fixed homewards from Dalien and there were also reports that Toscana 63,159 dwt was fixed from Singapore, but further information was lacking.

The Halla-relet K Fortune 70,135 dwt was rumoured fixed for 12 months in the east at $10,500 daily, and Oakby 64,197 dwt went delivery Aqaba Dec 15/30 for a similar period to unnamed charterers at $9,500 daily.

In the Atlantic, Bocimar fixed OBO tonnage for about 70,000 coal Hampton Roads/Terneuzen and Ghent at $7.50. Flag Karin 67,826 dwt was reported booked by Aimcor for petcoke from US Gulf to the Med on private terms.
